CREATE TABLE "public"."admin_users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamptz,
  "mustChangePassword" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'ADMIN' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "admin_users_role_check_1954e8c0" CHECK ("role" IN ('USER', 'ADMIN')),
  CONSTRAINT "admin_users_status_check_3a7c0f48" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'DELETED'))
)
